haftalar.o: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will create a colourful poster about a fictional international school, including people, places, rules, school clubs, and countries. They will describe important school staff such as the headmaster/headmistress or teachers, highlight places such as the library or sports field, and list three key rules such as “Be on time” or “No running in the corridor”. The poster will also include information about two school clubs with simple descriptions of their activities. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme.
